18. Melchiſedeth † S. Hierom being carneſtly requeſted by Euagrius, to
geue his iudgement touching Melchiſedech, whom a nameles author had Old hereſ
endeuored to proue to be the Holie Ghoſt, plainly confuteth that crror: as alſo concerning
an other error of Origen and Didymus ſaying, he was an Angel. Likewiſe 5. Melchiſedech:
Epiphanius (hereſi g5. & 76) relateth and condemneth a third errot, of ſome
that thought him to be the Sonne of God. Theſe two Fathers, and S. Auguſtin
( L. de hereſibus her. 34.) and diuers others, whom S. Hierom alleageth proue
